description:
Returns the plain-document surface of one MCP host: which standard discovery paths answer (well-known mcp, agent card, x402, ai-catalog, owners, llms.txt, openapi, server.json, robots, sitemap), and an openapi audit: operations with no security declaration, security schemes referenced but undefined, request bodies an indexer cannot read (no properties), and payment accepts that collapse on one key. It makes thirteen requests to the server named and takes as long as they take, so call it on a line: a call cut for time returns nothing.
$0.000001 per millisecond on a line.
Paid, on a line. With no wallet code, ZEAM :: Pass buys the time and opens the line for you, with a pass (https://mcp.zeamprism.com/pass) or your own wallet: https://mcp.zeamprism.com/how-to-pay
Example: {"url":"https://mcp.zeamprism.com/mcp"}

line.description: Optional. A line credential, for a client that cannot send the x-line header or _meta["zeam-pass/line"]: the call runs on that line's time.

url.description: string — the MCP endpoint, absolute http(s) URL, e.g. https://host/mcp. Private and internal names and addresses are refused.

name: attest_discovery

anyOf.description: every request made, in the order sent: method, url, request headers of note, status, ms; a request that drew no answer has status 0 and its error, a redirect followed is listed in redirects, and a request still unanswered when a report was cut has unanswered: true
paths, operations, security per op, undefined schemes, unindexable request bodies, collapsing accepts
each standard discovery path → status, content type, bytes
